meta.name: dot-ai-prd-update-decisions
meta.description: Update PRD based on design decisions and strategic changes made during conversations

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据对话中的设计决策更新产品需求文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在产品讨论中频繁调整需求，需要同步更新PRD
copy.tagline_en: Update PRD based on design decisions from conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently adjust requirements during discussions and need to keep PRD updated

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你更新产品需求文档（PRD），根据对话中的设计决策和战略变化，自动识别需要修改的部分并提出更新建议。
howto.when: 当你在对话中做出设计决策、架构选择或范围调整时，可以要求 Claude 更新对应的 PRD 文件。

say.text: 根据我们刚才的讨论，更新这个 PRD。
say.note: Claude 会分析对话并建议 PRD 修改。

say.text: 把新的架构决策记录到 PRD 决策日志里。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you update a Product Requirements Document (PRD) based on design decisions and strategic changes made during conversations, identifying sections that need modification and proposing updates.
howto.when_en: When you make design decisions, architecture choices, or scope adjustments during a conversation, you can ask Claude to update the corresponding PRD file.

say_en.text: Update this PRD based on our discussion.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the conversation and suggest PRD changes.

say_en.text: Log the new architecture decision in the PRD decision log.
say_en.note: Claude will add a decision entry.
